title: В целом хорошо, но требует доработки
content:
Игра, в целом, достаточна интересна с точки зрения задумки, однако на данном этапе есть еще проблемы, которые нужно решать:
1) учитывая кроссплатформенность - очень не хватает какого-то движа. Тупо бегать ловить зверушек на уровне 40+ персонажа очень скучно
2) часто очень глючат сервера. От этого проблемы с подключением, входом, зависаниями внутри игры
3) было бы интереснее, если бы эволюционный путь персонажей был более длинным и разнообразным, чем в нынешнем варианте
4) мир университета очень маленький и вообще непонятно зачем он существует вообще. Там ничего нет дополняющего Идиллию с точки зрения геймплея

6) если в дальнейшем дадут возможность (даже за дорого) скрещивать Анимо между собой с целью получить какие-то крутые особенные комбинации - это будет вау как круто
7) расширение локации. Хотелось бы карту гораздо больше, чем сейчас. Хочется больше именно разнообразных зверушек при этом, не 150 окрасок одной и той же зверушки

title: Predatory Transmogrify System for Legendary Aniimo

author: BestBoy28
title: Was almost there
content:
You’d think that after every single anticipated game having a PRE-DOWNLOAD that people would start to realize “oh, maybe servers just aren’t accessible till actual release.” They must be kids and if they are why are their parents not inquiring on what’s they’re up to.

All that said, the game is disappointing…I was expecting to see other players roaming the wild areas and a feeling of a live world. Unfortunately though, you only see a few players at outposts or the town square, and they’re ghost towns. The game uses the “swap types” rule with chests and such needing to be opened by a particular monster. The game is OBSESSED with making you swap to fire and the emberpuppies…It’s so aggravating. I don’t care for any current fire monsters so I don’t keep them in my party and I have to swap it around to burn the 511th thorny vine or random dog bomb. Maybe the devs were having a hard time imagining how to use other types in the wild areas though it seems easy.

Then, sooo many of the monsters in the overworld are NPCs…Yep, see a new mon, pull up the cube and-Oh…CANT CATCH. There are waaayyy to many of these instances and then some make you turn into what they are and do some obnoxious “Pack Integration” bull that forces you to, again, ruin your party for and annoying mission running back and forth as a squirrel or of course…Emberpuppy…I think these missions are creative, but not entertaining to the point I ignore all of them now. Another obnoxious over used thing is the amber timed trial. I just don’t do them, Im done. 
There are some nifty designs then you’re having the game throw those generic freakin’ “It turns into a woman”, “It turns into a girl”, “it turns into [insert female trope].
Hey I don’t mind humanoid things and often like them, but it gets to a point…Every cliche, The furry moth is going to be a woman, the flower is going to be a woman, the turnip is going to be a woman, the shell is going to be a woman (the second form is perfect and the line shoulda stayed in that theme, but nope, third form is some short feminine warrior girl). 

Make some male ones that actually resemble men instead of furries. The furries are fine, but it’s obvious the devs are going the “Woman type monster looks like a literal human woman. Man type monster is a masculine bipedal animal.” route and it’s such a boring sight at this point.

Wish it was a real mmo, didn’t have a fire monster check on every chest, didn’t require Emberpuppies(and I hate dogs too) for every world mission, shook up the humanoid theme a bit and be more creative, didnt constantly “CANT CATCH” me on every new monster I see, didnt have obnoxious “fit in with these monsters” missions, had less cut scenes, had a better “title up” function that didn’t waste my time, didnt have boring genshin dungeons, didnt have the same two monsters wandering the different areas of the overworld, theres quite a bit more but Im tired of typing.
